game.name: Deadliest Catch : Alaskan Storm (USA)
game.desc: Deadliest Catch: Alaskan Storm is an action game for Xbox 360 inspired by the TV show of the same name, where we are shown fishermen risking their lives to go and find precious crabs that only live in the rough waters of the Bering Sea. You are the captain and it is up to you to steer the boat to its goal, you must also choose your crew carefully to be as efficient as possible.
